effects.text: Remove one Exhaustion level on yourself, **or** end one of: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, Stunned. Use `!i effect <name> -end <condition>` or `!cc reset <exhaustion counter>` accordingly.

automation.text: Recharges on a Long Rest. You may instead take 1 level of Exhaustion (no action required) to restore this use immediately.
